date: Nov 16, 2026 · Week 2 / Day 1 · Decision-driven meetings and tradeoffs

cards.title: Open with the decision
cards.question: PCIe Gen5 margin is 0.8 dB below target. What should a 15-minute review decide?
cards.selfCheck: Define the gate: reroute now or accept a bounded validation risk. Exercise: open with decision, options, evidence needed and decision owner in 20 seconds.
cards.prompt: Role-play a PCIe design review. Challenge my 20-second opening and help me turn technical status into a clear decision request.

cards.title: Two paths, one recommendation
cards.question: A via redesign recovers 0.6 dB but costs four days. How do you frame the choice?
cards.selfCheck: Compare margin gained, confidence, schedule exposure and fallback; recommend one path conditionally. Exercise: write a two-option decision table and one-sentence recommendation.
cards.prompt: Act as SI lead and program manager. Pressure-test my conditional via-redesign recommendation, including margin, confidence and four-day schedule impact.

cards.title: Agree on proof before debate
cards.question: EM predicts 53 Ω while TDR shows 55 Ω. What evidence ends the meeting?
cards.selfCheck: Set a correlation tolerance, measurement calibration check, named owner and deadline before discussing signoff. Exercise: propose a pass/fail gate in three sentences.
cards.prompt: Simulate a contentious EM/TDR review. Make me define an objective acceptance criterion, calibration checks and the next decision checkpoint.

cards.title: One owner for the decision
cards.question: Board, package and VRM teams disagree on a 19 MHz PDN peak. Who decides next steps?
cards.selfCheck: Assign one system-level decision owner while keeping each team's evidence owner explicit. Exercise: close a meeting with owner, deliverable, due time and escalation trigger.
cards.prompt: Role-play VRM, package and board leads disagreeing over a 19 MHz PDN resonance. Coach me to gain alignment without formal authority.

cards.title: End with a reversible call
cards.question: A 3 dB NEXT miss threatens layout freeze. How do you avoid an endless review?
cards.selfCheck: Recommend reroute or conditional freeze with a dated validation gate and rollback trigger. Exercise: deliver a 30-second decision memo: choice, rationale, risk, owner, checkpoint.
cards.prompt: Give me a release-gate scenario involving a 3 dB NEXT miss. Score my 30-second decision memo for clarity, tradeoffs, reversibility and ownership.
